meta.title: Send your fresh fish requirements
meta.description: Send your fish requirements to AZAFCO International: species, weight grade, packing, quantity and destination. Prices are confirmed per order.

hero.title: Send your requirements
hero.intro: Open a prepared message, fill in the blank lines and send it from your company email or business WhatsApp. That lets us confirm who is asking, and our replies always come from the azafco.com.eg domain.

short_hero.corporate_intro: For partnerships, investment or other business topics. Write from your company email; no product details needed.
short_hero.documents_intro: Ask from your company email for product specifications or the company profile. We confirm what we can share for your request.

aside.title: What happens after you write to us
steps: The export team reviews your requirements against the specification and current availability.
We contact you to confirm the details and any open points.
Prices, quantity, packing and terms are confirmed in writing for each order.
aside.no_promise: Sending your requirements does not commit you or us to an order. Prices are confirmed per order.
prepare: Quantity per shipment and how often
Air or road freight, and arrival airport or border crossing
aside.attach_text: Attach your specification or packing sheet to the email if you have one.
